name: Social scheduler
description: Schedules short video posts through your own Postiz (self-hosted free, or Postiz cloud). Postiz posts at each slot, so self-host it on a machine that stays on. Needs POSTIZ_URL and POSTIZ_API_KEY. Every post is external.

actions.title: Schedule clips as posts, one batch

posts.description: Path to a JSON list of {clip, platform, title, caption, hashtags, slot}.

tiktok_privacy.description: SELF_ONLY until TikTok has audited your developer app; unaudited apps can only post privately.
